title: AI Portfolio Chatbot
content: The AI Portfolio Chatbot is an AI-powered chat widget embedded into the portfolio that lets visitors ask questions about Cihan Erenler, his skills, and his projects in a conversational way. The project was created to provide a more interactive way for visitors to explore the portfolio and showcase the ability to build and deploy real-world AI applications. The idea was to create an AI assistant that knows the background, skills, and projects and can be embedded as a chat widget on any website. The main challenges were setting up a production-like environment on a Hetzner server, configuring PostgreSQL with the pgvector extension for vector search, and wiring up a secure SSH-based workflow from the local machine. Additionally, there was a need for a clean way to expose the chatbot as an embeddable iframe without overcomplicating the architecture. The solution involved building a Node.js + Express backend that stores portfolio data as vector embeddings in PostgreSQL using pgvector and performs RAG-style retrieval for each user question. The chat UI is a small Vite-powered frontend that runs inside an iframe, and a simple embed script is exposed so it can be dropped into any page with a single script tag. The result is a fast, always-on AI assistant that demonstrates both full-stack skills and experience with AI tooling. Technologies used: Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, pgvector, OpenAI, Vite. GitHub: https://github.com/CihanErenler/portfolio-ai-chatbot-app

title: Car Dealer Website
content: The Car Dealer Website is an online platform where users can browse available cars and view details of each car. Users can filter available cars based on various criteria such as brand, model, and price. Users can also preview individual cars and add them to the shopping cart. The project originated from the need to create a user-friendly and functional car dealer website that allows users to easily browse and purchase cars online. The primary challenges included implementing effective car filtering and integrating with a backend server to store car data. To overcome these challenges, React, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, and Express were utilized. A proxy server was created to handle the API requests. Technologies used: React, Tailwind CSS, React Router, Axios, Node.js, Express. GitHub: https://github.com/CihanErenler/Garage35, Preview: https://garage35.fi/

title: Markdown Note Taking Application
content: NoteDock is a dynamic markdown note-taking application that seamlessly combines the simplicity of markdown with the power of a feature-rich note management system. The idea behind this project was to create a versatile note-taking application that merges the simplicity of markdown with advanced note management capabilities. One of the challenges faced was finding the right balance between a user-friendly interface and feature-rich functionalities. To address this, React, Styled-components, and React Router were employed. The completed project is available on GitHub and live on Netlify. Technologies used: React, Styled-components, React Router. GitHub: https://github.com/CihanErenler/markdown-note-taking-offline, Preview: https://notedockio.netlify.app

title: Movie Search App
content: The Movie Search App is designed to allow users to display trending movies and TV shows, view details of specific films, and search for movies using queries. This project emerged from the need to create a centralized platform for users to explore trending movies, view details, and easily search for specific films. A key challenge was integrating movie data effectively and implementing a robust search functionality. To tackle these challenges, React, CSS, React Router, and Material UI were utilized. The completed project is available on GitHub and live on Netlify. Technologies used: React, CSS, React Router, Material UI. GitHub: https://github.com/CihanErenler/react-movie-app, Preview: https://cihan-react-movieapp.netlify.app/

title: Color Generator

This project originated from the need to create a versatile color generation tool that provides users with the ability to generate and copy colors easily. A significant challenge was developing a tool that efficiently generates color variations and allows users to copy the generated colors seamlessly. To address these challenges, React, CSS, React Color, and React Icons were employed. The completed project is available on GitHub and live on Netlify. Technologies used: React, CSS, React Color, React Icons. GitHub: https://github.com/CihanErenler/react-color-generator, Preview: https://c-react-color-generator.netlify.app/

title: Weather App

The primary challenge was integrating weather data effectively and designing a simple yet informative user interface. To overcome these challenges, JavaScript and CSS were employed. The completed project is available on GitHub and live on Netlify. Technologies used: JavaScript, CSS. title: Portfolio Website Technical Details
content: The portfolio website (portfilio-website-v2) is a personal portfolio website built with React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. The frontend uses React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, React Router, and Framer Motion for animations. Build tools include Vite, TypeScript, and ESLint. Styling is handled with Tailwind CSS, PostCSS, and Autoprefixer. Key dependencies include framer-motion, localforage, match-sorter, react, react-dom, react-icons, react-router-dom, and sort-by. Features include responsive design, dark mode support, project showcase with filtering, resume/CV display, contact form, single project detail pages, and smooth animations with Framer Motion. The website has navigation to home, projects, resume, and contact pages.
